source.how: Mcts (browser options: cpuct 1.0, batch 1, no noise, temp 0, s1 off, race 0), expert model small-2p-adjacent-expert (F16 widened to F32), scalar reference Network; the tree after simulation k is the search with sims=k (deterministic); Q and N after each step follow from path and values

meta.formula: Q + cpuct * P * sqrt(max(1, N_parent)) / (1 + N); an unvisited edge has Q = node mean - fpu, with mean = (value + sum of backed up values) / (1 + visits)
